crossRefs.note: So Samuel went back with Saul; and Saul worshiped Yahweh.

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: So Samuel went back with Saul; and Saul worshiped Yahweh.
translations.bsb: So Samuel went back with Saul, and Saul worshiped the LORD.
translations.kjv: So Samuel turned again after Saul; and Saul worshipped the LORD.
translations.asv: So Samuel turned again after Saul; and Saul worshipped Jehovah.
